# Northside Community Clinic — Same-day pediatric appointments

Starting August 5, Northside Community Clinic will reserve 12 same-day
appointment slots each weekday for urgent pediatric cases.

## How to request a same-day slot

A caregiver may request a same-day slot by calling the clinic. No app or online
account is required. A triage nurse decides whether a case is urgent under the
clinic's existing triage protocol; front-desk staff do not make that decision.

## What to expect

- Reserved slots not used that day are released to online booking at 14:00 for
  next-day appointments.
- The change is a six-week trial.
- During the trial, the clinic will measure pediatric waiting time and
  abandoned calls.
- The trial does not add clinicians and does not increase the clinic's total
  appointment capacity.

## Background

In the previous four weeks, 18 caregivers who called for a sick child were told
that no same-day appointment was available.
```

Northside Community Clinic is thrilled to announce an innovative new approach
that puts families first. Starting August 5, we will reserve 12 same-day
appointment slots each weekday for urgent pediatric cases.

## Key Benefits

- Fast and seamless access
- A family-centered experience
- Flexible online options

Caregivers can call the clinic to request a slot. A triage nurse uses the
existing triage protocol to decide whether a case is urgent. Front-desk staff
do not make this decision.

six-week trial will measure pediatric waiting time and abandoned calls. It does
not add clinicians or increase total appointment capacity. In the previous four
weeks, 18 caregivers calling about a sick child were told that no same-day
appointment was available.

children and families.

Caregivers should use the online portal to request an urgent same-day
appointment. Front-desk staff decide whether the request qualifies. The new
same-day program permanently expands the clinic's appointment capacity.
